brief.recommendation: Terminating the batch_replayable_inventory blocker (pid 315722) costs a 4-minute replay of an idempotent, may_interrupt job (BIZ-2). Waiting would cost ~$185,706 in lost checkout revenue and exceeds the 60s degradation tolerance (BIZ-4). Checkout is at 32% success with $12,437/min at risk (BIZ-3), far below the 95% SLO. No protected settlements are in flight (DB-2). The change calendar is unavailable (BIZ-5) but returns UNKNOWN, not an active consult_owner window. All invariants I1-I4 are satisfied.

audit.report: A replayable batch job (inventory_reconcile, pid 315722) blocked checkout for 86.8 seconds, dropping success to 32% and putting $12,437/min of revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed terminating the blocker after trade-off analysis showed waiting would cost ~$185,706 versus a 4-minute replay of the idempotent job. The Continuity Guardian objected twice, requiring change-calendar evidence that was unavailable due to a federation outage. A business invariant override accepted the termination, but the guardian repeated the objection, forcing escalation to inventory-platform with no action executed. Checkout remained degraded at escalation.
audit.root_cause: The inventory_reconcile batch worker held an idle-in-transaction lock for 4.1+ seconds, blocking checkout sessions and triggering a recovery negotiation that deadlocked on a missing change-calendar check.
lessons: Add a cached fallback for biz.change_calendar (inventory_reconcile) so the invariant check succeeds even when the federation is down.
Pre-register inventory_reconcile as 'may_interrupt' with an explicit change-calendar entry so the Continuity Guardian can approve termination in round 1.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian adapted correctly after the trade-off data arrived, but the Continuity Guardian wasted two rounds re-raising the same calendar objection after the invariant override had already accepted the evidence gap, delaying resolution by ~60 seconds.
follow_ups: Restore change-calendar federation and add a static allow-list for inventory_reconcile.
Run a drill: simulate the same blocker with calendar down and verify termination executes in <30s.
Add a dashboard alert for 'idle in transaction > 2s on batch_replayable_inventory' to catch the pattern earlier.
